description: Optional stop-time review gate for Codex Companion.

args: const cp=require('node:child_process'),fs=require('node:fs'),p=require('node:path');let r=process.env.CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT;if(!r){console.error('Codex plugin hook skipped: CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT is not set.');process.exit(0);}if(process.platform==='win32'&&/^\/[A-Za-z]\//.test(r))r=r[1]+':/'+r.slice(3);const script=p.join(r,'scripts',process.argv[1]);if(!fs.existsSync(script)){console.error(`Codex plugin hook skipped: ${script} was not found.`);process.exit(0);}const x=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,[script,...process.argv.slice(2)],{stdio:'inherit',env:process.env,windowsHide:true});if(x.error)throw x.error;process.exit(x.status??1);
